svg.title: Evidence Gate Lab: inspect the decision
svg.desc: Implemented deterministic pipeline: an authorized read request is ranked over public passages, complete passages fit a word budget, normalized quotes are checked, then extractive evidence is returned or the request abstains. No model call.
svg.text: An answer should leave an evidence trail.
Authorized read → supported extract OR explicit abstention
Invented fixtures · deterministic decisions · no model or external tool call
